brief_rationale: All five responsibility chain items are met with appropriate evidence. The doctor used workspace queries, requested medication verification from reliable sources, provided comprehensive red-flag education, outlined follow-up priorities including the left renal nodule, and obtained patient teach-back. Multiple high-order points were triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact, particularly in real-world constraint navigation (HO1) and patient-state sensitive communication (HO3). Closure is safe, executable, and traceable.
